description: This Go source file defines functions and data structures for handling repository resource completions, including argument resolvers for owner, repo, branch, sha, tag, prNumber, and path, as well as a main handler function for completion requests.

methods.name: RepositoryResourceCompletionHandler
methods.description: Returns a completion handler function that processes completion requests for repository resources, resolving arguments and returning possible completions.

methods.name: completeOwner
methods.description: Provides a list of possible owner names (users and organizations), filtered by input value.

methods.name: completeRepo
methods.description: Provides a list of repositories for a given owner, filtered by input value.

methods.name: completeBranch
methods.description: Lists branches for a specified repository, filtered by input value.

methods.name: completeSHA
methods.description: Lists commit SHAs for a specified repository, filtered by input value.

methods.name: completeTag
methods.description: Lists tags for a specified repository, filtered by input value.

methods.name: completePRNumber
methods.description: Lists open pull request numbers for a specified repository, filtered by input value.

methods.name: completePath
methods.description: Provides file and directory path completions within a repository at a specific ref, filtered by input value.
